cases.detail: Event files are merged from shards and may arrive out of order. Replay must sort by timestamp and sequence before applying financial effects.
cases.title: unordered delivery

cases.detail: Retried ingestion can duplicate event ids. A duplicate id should be ignored, not rejected as an overdraft and not counted twice in balances.
cases.title: idempotent rebuild

cases.detail: Incremental rebuilds begin from a snapshot with balances and applied ids. The replay should not mutate caller-owned collections in surprising ways if it needs to derive a new state.
cases.title: opening snapshots

cases.detail: Withdrawals and transfers cannot make source balances negative. Rejected events should include a reason and must not be added to applied ids.
cases.title: overdraft rejection

cases.detail: Amounts are strings in event payloads. Decimal conversion keeps replay deterministic for currency values.
cases.title: decimal amounts

notes: These notes are not executed directly; the unittest suite is the scorer.
They are included so agents can practice selecting relevant context.
A correct implementation should be deterministic across repeated runs.
title: Event Store Snapshots
